name: Faceted Crystal Fragrance Bottle
description: A squat eau de parfum bottle cut from clear crystal glass with a dense diamond-cut facet pattern, capped with a smooth polished gold-tone dome.
materials: clear cut crystal glass, polished gold-tone metal cap
primaryColors: clear crystal with fractured refracted highlights, polished gold
negativeConstraints: Never render any text, logo, engraving, or wordmark on the crystal or the cap; never affix a paper or foil label to the crystal; never tint the crystal any color other than clear; never render a second cap or duplicate the facet pattern.
preservationNotes: Keep the crystal's diamond-cut facet pattern and its clear, colorless transparency consistent across every angle, with the same fractured/refracted highlight behavior wherever light crosses a facet edge; keep the cap's smooth polished gold-tone dome shape and mirror-bright finish, completely free of any engraving or marking, in every shot.
